notes: The houses as the sim reads them (NP_07 s2's schema, the fields the sim uses): the blessing line NP_07A authors for each (NP_08 s3: 'their personal quest + a REP or FEUD condition'), evaluated against the sim's ledgers with the house as the subject - BEAT_IN counts your wins against any fighter of that house, STYLE_PROOF by a style or (Petrov) by the house's own moves, WITNESS a dual won while the house's crest is up on the String Wall (Tagaq's without your crowd heat), the rest as C29 reads them; FEUD_RESOLVED reads the live feud graph for a pair on it, the flag for a feud off it. A met line blesses the house (and the overworld's blessing:<house> flag blesses it too); a blessing is recorded in the ledger with the day and how it came. A recruit of a blessed house is NATIVE and arrives with its natives unlocked (the library's house moves, the SECRET excepted: a SECRET is its gate event's, NP_07 s4); a recruit of an unblessed house arrives UNSANCTIONED (NP_07 s5): no home bonus on his house's moves, natives locked - sanctioned the moment the blessing lands. The cards the club begins with were recruited in the story before the ledger: NATIVE. Iron has no blessing; the sealed house blesses itself (Q-SEALED) and has no card in the sim. The traits are NP_07 s3's nine authored effects (`traits`), executed on both corners where a boss has an analogue (PAC-078); the three s8 variants are named, not executed. The provisional edge and the mutation rules are the feud graph's (feud_graph.v1.json), attached at load.

status.NATIVE: a member by blood whose house has blessed the club, or a card the club began with: natives unlocked, the home bonus live (NP_06 s3)
status.UNSANCTIONED: a member recruited around his family (NP_08 s3): natives locked, no home bonus until the blessing lands (NP_07 s5)

trait_rules: NP_07 s3: 'Traits are house-locked, never transferable - blood/adoption only.' A fighter carries his house's trait when the trait is authored (the three variants are named, not executed: set `executed` to run one as its base), his lineage is blood (the META qualifiers above) and he is not disowned (NP_07 s5: 'House trait inactive until reconciliation'); UNSANCTIONED keeps the trait - NP_07 s5 takes only the home bonus away. The last of a dead lineage doubles her trait (every magnitude's delta and every use count x2). The sealed house's trait is offline until the unsealing. Stat multipliers clamp to 99 and every multiplier to NP_06 s4's 1.5.
